name: NWFTS
subtitle: NWorks's File Transfer System
description: Send files and folders directly from one device to another, like a phone call. Nothing is uploaded to a cloud, and every connection is end-to-end encrypted. Works with NWFTS on Windows, macOS and Linux. On iPhone, keep NWFTS open to receive calls.

apps.name: NWFTS
apps.subtitle: Send files directly, like a phone call
apps.localizedDescription: Send files and folders directly from one device to another, like a phone call. Nothing is uploaded to a cloud, and every connection is end-to-end encrypted. Works with NWFTS on Windows, macOS and Linux. On iPhone, keep NWFTS open to receive calls.

versions.localizedDescription:
• NWFTS for iPhone, installed with AltStore. It finds computers on the same Wi-Fi, calls and receives calls while it is open, and saves received files in the Files app.
• Narrow windows and phones get a tab bar at the bottom.
• Updated networking library; calls with 0.2.0 keep working.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: NWFTS finds computers running NWFTS on your network and connects to them directly to send files.
